Italicize "class I" and "Class II", underline "d(X)", and color "misclassified", the arrows "⇒", "δ_i", "-1", and "> 0" in red (#FF0000).
7. Below the first line, place the second line in black (#000000) serif: "If X ∈ class II and misclassified as Class I then d(X) will be >0 ⇒ δ_i = +1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i > 0". 8. Add a tan (#F5E6CA) rectangle with a dark-red (#C00000) border in the middle region (x 3-97%, y 41-63%).

13. Inside the bottom tan panel, place the heading "Minimize the Error using Gradient Descent with step η" with "Gradient Descent" in blue (#0000FF) bold and the remaining text in black (#000000) italic serif.
14. In the bottom panel, place the first update-rule line in black (#000000) serif: "W^(updated) = W^(old) - η ∂Error/∂W where ∂Error/∂W = Σ_{misclassified vectors} δ_i X_i". Italicize "where". 15. Below the first line, place the second update-rule line in black (#000000) serif: "W^(updated) = W^(old) - η Σ_{misclassified vectors ONLY (i)} δ_i X_i". Color the Σ subscript "misclassified vectors ONLY (i)" and the word "ONLY" in red (#FF0000). Draw a larger green rounded rectangle (#E8F5E9 fill, #2E7D32 border) around the entire expression.
16. Add a small green (#2E7D32) curved arrow inside the bottom panel pointing from the first green highlight down to the second green highlight.
